crossRefs.note: By faith, he kept the Passover, and the sprinkling of the blood, that the destroyer of the firstborn should not touch…

people.name: Aaron

people.name: Israel

people.name: Moses

translations.web: The children of Israel went and did so; as Yahweh had commanded Moses and Aaron, so they did.
translations.bsb: And the Israelites went and did just what the LORD had commanded Moses and Aaron.
translations.kjv: And the children of Israel went away, and did as the LORD had commanded Moses and Aaron, so did
translations.asv: And the children of Israel went and did so; as Jehovah had commanded Moses and Aaron, so did they.
